description: Spec Goal mandates 9 shared SHELL scripts (loop-healthcheck.sh, loop-roi.sh, loop-improve.py, loop-scale.sh, loop-propose.sh, cross-learn-read.sh, cross-learn-share.sh, adversary-daily.sh, self-recover.sh) in ~/anicca/skills/_shared/ as the entire 'I/O-BOUND layer' that EVERY launchd plist invokes. ZERO of these 9 scripts exist on disk. Without them, no slot can actually be wired into launchd; the entire Goal condition (launchd plist invokes loop-healthcheck.sh <slot>) is unmet. Only the pure-Python lib/ helpers exist; the actual deliverable per spec is absent.

evidence.snippet: Glob skills/_shared/*.sh and skills/_shared/*.py shows only lib/*.py + __tests__/*.py — no loop-healthcheck.sh, no loop-roi.sh, no adversary-daily.sh, no self-recover.sh.
